paper_title: Probing axions with neutron star inspirals and other stellar processes
coupling_convention: log10(GeV/F_a) — inverse axion decay constant 1/F_a in GeV^-1, plotted as base-10 logarithm (i.e., GeV/F_a from 1e-20 to 1e-6, equivalently F_a from 1e6 to 1e20 GeV)
notes: Theory paper (Hook & Huang, arXiv:1708.08464) on light QCD axions sourced by dense objects. Figure 6 presents constraints on the m_a vs 1/f_a (AxionMass) plane: new exclusions derived by the authors from direct Earth/Sun measurements (theta-angle observables, Borexino), plus a conservative binary-pulsar exclusion, and projections for white dwarfs, neutron stars, and Advanced LIGO neutron-star inspirals. However, all limit contours exist only in Figure 6 with no numerical table or explicit boundary values in the text (only anchors like f_a > 4e8 GeV from SN1987A, m_a < sqrt(eps)*16 meV, and f_a ~ Mpl/10 for gravity-strength force). Cannot reliably extract (mass, f_a) pairs, so data_points is empty.
